hooks.command: THURBOX_SIGNAL_TURN=start thurbox-cli session signal --state working >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

p=$(cat); p=${p%%'"tool_input"'*}; case "$p" in *'"agent_type":"'[!\"]*) w=${p#*'"agent_id":"'}; THURBOX_SIGNAL_WORK=${w%%\"*} thurbox-cli session signal --state working >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; *'"agent_id"'*) ;; *) thurbox-cli session signal --state working >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; true

p=$(cat); p=${p%%'"tool_input"'*}; case "$p" in *'"agent_type":"'[!\"]*) w=${p#*'"agent_id":"'}; THURBOX_SIGNAL_WORK=${w%%\"*} thurbox-cli session signal --state working >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; *'"agent_id"'*) ;; *) thurbox-cli session signal --state working >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; true
p=$(cat); case "$p" in *'"agent_type":"'[!\"]*) case "$p" in *'"agent_id":"'[!\"]*) w=${p#*'"agent_id":"'}; thurbox-cli session signal --work-start "${w%%\"*}" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac ;; esac; true
p=$(cat); case "$p" in *'"agent_type":"'[!\"]*) case "$p" in *'"agent_id":"'[!\"]*) w=${p#*'"agent_id":"'}; thurbox-cli session signal --work-end "${w%%\"*}" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac ;; esac; true
case "$(cat | sed -n 's/.*"message":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')" in *permission*|*Permission*|*approval*|*approve*) thurbox-cli session signal --state blocked >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; true
